inlines.v: UG'LY, adjective [See Hack.[ Deformed; offensive to the sight; contrary to beauty; hateful; as an ugly person; an ugly face. O I have pass'd a miserable night, so full of ugly sights, of ghastly dreams. Fellow, begone; I cannot bear thy sight; this news hath made thee a most ugly man.
